scope: Exploratory 0PN one-tag measurement on a projected wall-carrier path in a rotationally symmetric four-spatial-dimensional held flared mouth. The local two-attachment contact and one-dimensional ordered elastic receiver are explicit hypotheses. Rupture work is excluded; the fate of the stored elastic energy removed at rupture is open.
preparation: R=1, Q=0.25, delayed flare, half reference external head, no initial incoming shear wave. epsilon=1e-3 in model length units. Unit transverse material density, shear modulus and contact area. The ordered end includes the mass of half a spatial cell. Both branches keep the same partner and differ in depth by .04. Perpendicular registry is fixed at 1/8 pitch in the main experiment; loss occurs when local chi/2 reaches absolute registry. No contact work is added after the last disconnection. Work fractions use the elastic prestrain of that specific tag at center order .95.
kinematics: The source is steady. Travel time is reconstructed from the tangent-projected carrier. Zero holding force on a frozen copy is measured via two slip perturbations at ±2 epsilon. With no live attachments the entire force curve is zero and the recorded intercept is null. Half-amplitude and reversal controls keep the same probe range. Midpoint forces, velocities and k values are step quantities; event readings are instantaneous one-sided limits.
energy: Smooth stiffness changes, loss at disconnection, signed mechanical work at the ordered endpoint and signed work across the receiver cut use separate channels. Cut section is at .25 with the crossing spring excluded from the downstream energy. The work into the receiver equals its kinetic and strain energy relative to uniform unstrained entry. The chip-scale stiffness and geometrical capture rules are independent assumptions; multiplication into a population stiffness would require checking both. No measurement of a microscopic site in the full brane or of free acceleration.

"""Read one junction's identity, zero-load slip and ordered-end work through breakup."""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss
from scipy.linalg import solve_banded

from mouth_contact_tracking import WallTrace
from mouth_order_wave_pulse import digest, emit


PRESTRAIN = 1e-3
SPAN = .04
CUT = .25
LINE_LENGTH = 8.


def force_probe(k, offsets):
    """Displace a frozen copy. Probe motion never enters the work history."""
    slips = np.array([-2., 2.])*PRESTRAIN
    forces = (k*(offsets-slips[:, None])).sum(axis=1)
    if not np.any(k):
        return forces, None
    if not forces[0] > 0 > forces[1]:
        raise ValueError('Frozen force probe does not bracket zero')
    root = slips[0] - forces[0]*np.diff(slips)[0]/np.diff(forces)[0]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(k @ (offsets-root), 0., atol=1e-16)
    return forces, float(root)


def depth_steps(trace, gates, shifts, dx):
    # Split at every force discontinuity and FE change; integrate the carrier clock.
    breaks = np.unique(np.r_[gates, *(trace.edges-s for s in [0., *shifts])])
    breaks = breaks[(breaks >= min(gates)) & (breaks <= max(gates))]
    roots, weights = leggauss(5)
    depth = [breaks[0]]
    for left, right in zip(breaks[:-1], breaks[1:], strict=True):
        count = max(1, int(np.ceil(trace.transit(left, right, 5)/(.22*dx))))
        depth.extend(np.linspace(left, right, count+1)[1:])
    depth = np.asarray(depth)
    width = np.diff(depth)[:, None]
    samples = depth[:-1, None]+width*(roots+1)/2
    dt = np.sum(width*weights/(2*trace.speed(samples)), axis=1)
    return depth, dt


def run_case(trace, mesh, dx, registry, offsets, name, folder, frozen=False, span=SPAN):
    shifts = np.array([-span/2, span/2])
    start, end = (trace.crossing(c) for c in (.95, .01))
    # Fixed material features occupy an angular row of pitch one. The transverse
    # shear and the registry are perpendicular. Each branch keeps its partner ID
    # until the shrinking window no longer covers its marked feature.
    breaks = trace.crossing(2*abs(registry))-shifts
    if not np.all((start < breaks) & (breaks < end)):
        raise ValueError('Selected tag does not break inside the acquisition window')
    depth, dt = depth_steps(trace, [start, end, trace.crossing(.5), *breaks], shifts, dx)
    chi = trace.sample(trace.chi, depth[:, None]+shifts)[0]
    center_order = trace.sample(trace.chi, depth)[0]
    if frozen:
        chi[:] = chi[0]
        center_order[:] = center_order[0]
    gap = chi/2-abs(registry)
    intact = np.ones_like(shifts, dtype=bool)
    entry_k = chi[0]/2
    _, baseline = force_probe(entry_k, offsets)
    initial_energy = .5*entry_k @ (offsets-baseline)**2
    times = np.r_[0., np.cumsum(dt)]

    # Unit-area shear strip, rho=mu=1. The endpoint owns half a cell of ordered
    # material. Its velocity is a dynamic state; it is never assigned from force.
    n = round(LINE_LENGTH/dx)
    cut = round(CUT/dx)
    if abs(cut*dx-CUT)>1e-12 or times[-1] >= LINE_LENGTH:
        raise ValueError('Receiver must resolve the cut and outlast the record before reflection')
    mass = np.full(n, dx)
    mass[0] /= 2
    u, v = np.zeros(n), np.zeros(n)  # displacements relative to uniform entry offset
    diag = np.full(n, 2/dx)
    diag[0] = 1/dx
    band = np.zeros((3, n))
    events, probes, midpoints = [], [], []
    work = cut_work = broken_energy = softening = 0.
    rupture = None

    def read(tag, j):
        k = np.where(intact, chi[j]/2, 0.)
        forces, slip = force_probe(k, offsets)
        x = baseline+u[0]
        return dict(stage=tag, depth=depth[j], time=times[j], center_order=center_order[j],
                    lobe_order=chi[j].tolist(), overlap_margin=gap[j].tolist(),
                    live_lobes=intact.tolist(), wall_end_motion=0., ordered_end_slip=x,
                    ordered_end_velocity=v[0], force_on_ordered=k @ (offsets-x),
                    probe_forces=forces.tolist(), zero_force_slip=slip,
                    endpoint_work=work, cut_work=cut_work,
                    receiver_energy=.5*(mass @ v**2 + np.diff(np.r_[u, 0.]) @ np.diff(np.r_[u, 0.])/dx),
                    softening=softening, rupture_loss=broken_energy)

    probes.append(read('entry', 0))
    for j, step in enumerate(dt, start=1):
        k_left = np.where(intact, chi[j-1]/2, 0.)
        k_right = np.where(intact, chi[j]/2, 0.)
        k = (k_left+k_right)/2
        # Implicit midpoint. Use the force on the receiver from its external
        # contact and read its velocity from the integrated material field.
        f = np.diff(np.r_[u, 0.])/dx
        f[1:] -= f[:-1].copy()
        x_left = baseline+u[0]
        f[0] += k @ (offsets-x_left)
        scale = step**2/4
        band[0, 1:] = band[2, :-1] = -scale/dx
        band[1] = mass+scale*diag
        band[1, 0] += scale*k.sum()
        velocity = solve_banded((1, 1), band, mass*v+step*f/2, check_finite=False)
        next_u = u+step*velocity
        x_right = baseline+next_u[0]
        force = k @ (offsets-(x_left+x_right)/2)
        cut_force = ((u[cut-1]-u[cut])+(next_u[cut-1]-next_u[cut]))/(2*dx)
        work += step*force*velocity[0]
        cut_work += step*cut_force*velocity[cut]
        softening += .25*(k_left-k_right) @ ((offsets-x_left)**2+(offsets-x_right)**2)
        kprobes, intercept = force_probe(k, offsets)
        midpoints.append([times[j-1]+step/2, step, (depth[j]+depth[j-1])/2,
                          *intact, *k, *kprobes, np.nan if intercept is None else intercept,
                          (x_left+x_right)/2, force, velocity[0], cut_force, velocity[cut]])
        u, v = next_u, 2*velocity-v
        lost = (depth[j] == breaks) & intact & (not frozen)
        if np.any(lost):
            np.testing.assert_allclose(gap[j, lost], 0., atol=1e-12)
            events.append(read('before_loss', j))
            broken_energy += .5*k_right[lost] @ (offsets[lost]-x_right)**2
            intact[lost] = False
            events.append(read('after_loss', j))
            if not np.any(intact):
                rupture = events[-1]
        if np.any(gap[j, intact] < -1e-12) or np.any(gap[j, ~intact] > 1e-12):
            raise ValueError('Contact history inconsistent with observed overlap')
        if abs(center_order[j]-.5)<1e-12:
            probes.append(read('half_order', j))
    finish = read('end_of_observation', len(depth)-1)
    probes.append(finish)
    cut_energy = .5*(mass[cut:] @ v[cut:]**2+np.sum(np.diff(np.r_[u[cut:], 0.])**2)/dx)
    stored = .5*(chi[-1]*intact/2) @ (offsets-baseline-u[0])**2
    eps_energy = PRESTRAIN**2
    for sample in [*events, *probes]:
        np.testing.assert_allclose(sample['receiver_energy'], sample['endpoint_work'], atol=eps_energy*2e-10, rtol=0)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cut_work, cut_energy, atol=eps_energy*2e-10, rtol=0)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(work+softening+broken_energy+stored, initial_energy, atol=eps_energy*2e-10, rtol=0)
    if (rupture is None) != frozen:
        raise ValueError('Unexpected break or censoring')
    if rupture is not None and work != rupture['endpoint_work']:
        raise ValueError('Extinct tag performed work')
    if frozen or span == 0 or np.all(offsets == 0.):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(work, 0., atol=eps_energy*1e-15)

    columns = ('time dt depth_midpoint live_upstream live_downstream k_upstream k_downstream '
               'probe_force_minus probe_force_plus zero_force_slip ordered_end_slip '
               'force_on_ordered ordered_end_velocity cut_force cut_velocity').split()
    output = folder / f'{name}.npz'
    np.savez_compressed(output, columns=columns, samples=midpoints)
    row = dict(test='tagged_contact', case=name, mesh=mesh, dx=dx, registry=registry, span=span,
               head=trace.head, intake=trace.intake, frozen=frozen, offsets=offsets.tolist(),
               wall_site='wall-0', ordered_site='ordered-0', lobes=['upstream','downstream'],
               probe_slips=[-2*PRESTRAIN, 2*PRESTRAIN], cut=CUT, initial_energy=initial_energy,
               status='still_connected' if frozen else 'broken', events=events, probes=probes,
               raw_path=str(output), raw_sha256=digest(output), fields=trace.hashes)
    emit(**row)
    return row


def main(folder):
    folder = Path(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    offsets = PRESTRAIN*np.array([-1., 1.])
    for mesh in (34, 48):
        trace = WallTrace(mesh, .5)
        for dx in (1/32, 1/64, 1/128):
            run_case(trace, mesh, dx, .125, offsets, f'n{mesh}_line{round(1/dx)}', folder)
    def control(name, registry=.125, offset_scale=1., **kwargs):
        return run_case(trace, 48, 1/128, registry, offsets*offset_scale, name, folder, **kwargs)
    control('alternate_tag', registry=.25)
    control('nonconverting', frozen=True)
    control('coincident', span=0.)
    control('no_prestrain', offset_scale=0.)
    reverse, half = control('reversed', offset_scale=-1.), control('half', offset_scale=.5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(reverse['events'][-1]['endpoint_work'],
                               4*half['events'][-1]['endpoint_work'], rtol=2e-11)

"""Passive two-attachment test along a measured wall transit at 0PN.

Lengths are tangential displacements in units of a small imposed mismatch.
Energies per contact area are in units of full-order stiffness times that
mismatch squared. A no-incoming-wave termination receives the sideways work.
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

from mouth_contact_tracking import WallTrace
from mouth_order_wave_pulse import emit


def measure(trace, span, impedance, offsets):
    shifts = np.array([-span/2, span/2])
    start = trace.crossing(.95)
    cuts = {level: trace.crossing(level) for level in (.5, .01, .0001, .000001)}
    end = cuts[.000001]
    # Break at element boundaries for the carrier and for both stiffness traces.
    shifted_edges = [trace.edges-offset for offset in [0., *shifts]]
    all_edges = np.unique(np.concatenate([*shifted_edges, [start], list(cuts.values())]))
    edges = all_edges[(all_edges >= start) & (all_edges <= end)]

    def stiffness(w):
        chi, gradient = trace.sample(trace.chi, w+shifts)
        return chi/2, gradient/2

    def unloaded(k):
        # Read the zero of the holding-force curve from two independent trial slips.
        probes = np.array([-2., 2.])
        loads = (k*(probes[:, None]-offsets)).sum(axis=1)
        return probes[0]-loads[0]*np.diff(probes)[0]/np.diff(loads)[0]

    initial, _ = stiffness(start)
    slip = unloaded(initial)
    initial_slip = slip
    stored = .5*np.dot(initial, (slip-offsets)**2)
    state = np.array([slip, 0., 0.])  # slip, work into the line, energy lost to softening
    readings = []
    for left, right in zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:], strict=True):
        width = right-left
        # The two gradients are linear within this interval. Verify both one-sided
        # endpoint values, without crossing into the neighboring finite element.
        d1 = stiffness(left+width*.25)[1]
        d3 = stiffness(left+width*.75)[1]
        if np.max([1.5*d1-.5*d3, 1.5*d3-.5*d1]) > 1e-11:
            raise ValueError('An attachment stiffens during the measured transit')
        if min(stiffness(right)[0]) <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Loss of a resolved attachment before the terminal reading')

        def rates(w, y):
            # Take the interior limit of the three FE traces at each subinterval end.
            interior = np.clip(w, left+width*1e-10, right-width*1e-10)
            k, dk = stiffness(interior)
            extension = y[0]-offsets
            force = -np.dot(k, extension)
            drift = trace.speed(interior)
            return [force/(impedance*drift), force**2/(impedance*drift),
                    -.5*np.dot(dk, extension**2)]

        solution = solve_ivp(rates, (left, right), state, method='DOP853', atol=2e-13, rtol=2e-10)
        if not solution.success:
            raise ArithmeticError(solution.message)
        state = solution.y[:, -1]
        for level, cut in cuts.items():
            if right != cut:
                continue
            k, _ = stiffness(right)
            remaining_energy = .5*np.dot(k, (state[0]-offsets)**2)
            readings.append(dict(order=level, depth=cut, unloaded_offset=unloaded(k),
                                 actual_offset=state[0], line_work=state[1],
                                 softening_loss=state[2], remaining_energy=remaining_energy))
    emit(span=span, impedance=impedance, offsets=offsets.tolist(),
         initial_unloaded=initial_slip, initial_energy=stored, readings=readings)
    for row in readings:
        np.testing.assert_allclose(row['line_work']+row['softening_loss']+row['remaining_energy'],
                                   stored, rtol=0, atol=3e-10)
        if row['line_work'] < 0 or row['softening_loss'] < -1e-13:
            raise ArithmeticError('Negative passive budget')
    if span == 0 or offsets[0] == offsets[1]:
        np.testing.assert_allclose([r['line_work'] for r in readings], 0, atol=1e-18)
    return readings


def main():
    for mesh in (34, 48):
        for head in (0., .5):
            trace = WallTrace(mesh, head)
            emit(test='junction_setup', mesh=mesh, head_fraction=head, intake=trace.intake,
                 field_sha256=trace.hashes)
            offsets = np.array([-1., 1.])
            measure(trace, 0., 1., offsets)
            main_case = measure(trace, .04, 1., offsets)
            if (mesh, head) == (48, .5):
                measure(trace, .04, 1., np.zeros(2))
                reverse = measure(trace, .04, 1., -offsets)
                for row, mirror in zip(main_case, reverse, strict=True):
                    np.testing.assert_allclose(mirror['unloaded_offset'], -row['unloaded_offset'], atol=1e-12)
                    np.testing.assert_allclose(mirror['line_work'], row['line_work'], atol=1e-12)
                for impedance in (.5, 2.):
                    measure(trace, .04, impedance, offsets)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--tagged-readouts', metavar='DIRECTORY',
                        help='track one site pair through breakup and save signed force and velocity traces')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.tagged_readouts:
        from mouth_tagged_contact import main as track_tag
        track_tag(args.tagged_readouts)
    else:
        main()

"""Reference continuum outgoing-wave integration from archived outermost Q2 nodal data."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.interpolate import PPoly

root = Path('_scratch/s11c')

def sample_carrier(n, h):
    with np.load(root / f'mouth_flared_delayed_n{n}/field.npz') as f:
        r,w = f['points'].T
        phasor = f['psi']
    with np.load(root / f'contact_supply_n{n}_01/order_{h:.5f}.npz') as f:
        order = f['chi']
    z = np.unique(w[(w > 1.2 - 1e-11) & (w < 2.45)])
    if len(z)%2 == 0:
        z = z[:-1]
    nodes = [np.argmax(np.where(v == w, r, -1)) for v in z]
    def polynomial(field):
        l,m,r = (field[nodes][q::2] for q in (0,1,2))
        l=l[:-1]; width=np.diff(z[::2])
        return PPoly(np.vstack([2*(l+r-2*m)/width**2,(4*m-3*l-r)/width,l]),z[::2],extrapolate=False)
    chi,psi = map(polynomial,[order,phasor])
    def elapsed_per_depth(w):
        t=(w-1.2)/1.85
        slope=6*t*t*(1-t)/1.85
        return (1+slope*slope)/(psi(w,1)/psi(w)).imag
    return z[::2],chi,elapsed_per_depth

def run(n,h,registration,span):
    ends, chi, metric = sample_carrier(n,h)
    offsets=np.array([-1.,1.])
    depth_shifts=np.array([-span/2,span/2])
    def cross(c):
        return brentq(lambda w: chi(w)-c,ends[0],ends[-1],xtol=5e-15)
    start = cross(.95)
    events = cross(2*registration)-depth_shifts
    # Events are exact on separate tag lobes. Break at all FE and event boundaries.
    elem = np.concatenate([ends,ends-depth_shifts[0],ends-depth_shifts[1]])
    stops = np.unique(np.r_[start,events,elem[(elem>start)&(elem<max(events))]])
    kstart=chi(start+depth_shifts)/2
    x = np.dot(offsets,kstart)/kstart.sum()
    e0 = .5*np.dot(kstart,(offsets-x)**2)
    state=np.array([0.,x,0.,0.])  # time, displacement, work, cumulative change of stiffness loss
    event_loss = 0.
    rows=[]
    dense=[]
    for a,b in zip(stops[:-1],stops[1:],strict=True):
        live=(a+b)/2<events
        def rates(w,z):
            if w==a or w==b:
                w=np.nextafter(w,(a+b)/2)
            k=live*chi(w+depth_shifts)/2
            dk=live*chi(w+depth_shifts,1)/2
            force=np.dot(k,offsets-z[1])
            g=metric(w)
            return [g,force*g,force**2*g,-.5*np.dot(dk,(offsets-z[1])**2)]
        sol=solve_ivp(rates,[a,b],state,method='DOP853',rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-14,dense_output=True)
        assert sol.success
        state=sol.y[:,-1]
        dense.append((a,b,state[0],sol.sol))
        if np.any(b==events):
            k=live*chi(b+depth_shifts)/2
            breaks=events==b
            Et=.5*k*(offsets-state[1])**2
            event_loss += Et[breaks].sum()
            after = k*(~breaks)
            assert abs(state[2]+state[3]+event_loss+Et[~breaks].sum()-e0)<1e-11
            rows.append(dict(w=b,order=chi(b).item(),t=state[0],x=state[1],xzero_before=np.dot(offsets,k)/k.sum(),
              xzero_after=np.dot(offsets,after)/after.sum() if after.sum() else None,
              work=state[2],work_fraction=state[2]/e0,break_loss=float(Et[breaks].sum()),closure=state[2]+state[3]+event_loss+Et[~breaks].sum()-e0))
    def delayed(cut):
        stop=state[0]-cut
        for a,b,t,func in dense:
            if t>=stop:
                depth=brentq(lambda w:func(w)[0]-stop,a,b)
                return func(depth)[2]/e0
        raise ValueError('missing return interval')
    print(json.dumps(dict(mesh=n,half_head=h,registration=registration,span=span,entry_energy=e0,
      initial_zero=np.dot(kstart,offsets)/kstart.sum(),events=rows,softening_loss=state[3],
      break_loss_sum=event_loss,work_at_cut_per_Eentry={str(c):delayed(c) for c in (.25,.5)})),flush=True)

for mesh in (34,48):
    for registration in (.125,.25):
        run(mesh,.5,registration,.04)

"""Verify the archive of synchronized force, velocity, active tags and frozen-copy probes."""
import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

root=Path('_scratch/s11c')
def records(p):return [json.loads(line) for line in p.read_text().splitlines()]
cf=records(root/'tagged_work_referee_01/stdout')
rows=records(root/'contact_tagged_work01/stdout')
for row in rows:
    path=Path(row['raw_path'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['raw_sha256']
    with np.load(path) as f:
        data=dict(zip(f['columns'],f['samples'].T,strict=True))
    frac=row['initial_energy']
    # Lifetime determined solely from the active pair's two graph flags.
    live=np.logical_or(data['live_upstream'],data['live_downstream'])
    assert np.all(np.diff(live.astype(float))<=0)
    assert (row['status']=='broken')== bool(np.any(~live))
    measured=np.dot(data['dt'][live],(data['ordered_end_velocity']*data['force_on_ordered'])[live])
    section=np.dot(data['dt'][live],(data['cut_velocity']*data['cut_force'])[live])
    end=(row['events'] or row['probes'])[-1]
    assert abs(measured-end['endpoint_work'])<2e-18
    assert abs(section-end['cut_work'])<2e-18
    assert np.all(data['force_on_ordered'][~live]==0) and np.all(np.isnan(data['zero_force_slip'][~live]))
    # Zero by interpolating the two copied readings with the opposite sign convention.
    a,b=(data[name][live] for name in ('probe_force_minus','probe_force_plus'))
    pmin,pmax=row['probe_slips']
    root_val=(a*pmax-b*pmin)/(a-b)
    assert np.max(abs(root_val-data['zero_force_slip'][live]))<2e-17
    print(json.dumps({'case':row['case'],'work_ratio':measured/frac if frac else None,
                      'cut_ratio':section/frac if frac else None,
                      'max_abs_after_break_force':np.max(abs(data['force_on_ordered'][~live])) if np.any(~live) else None}))

"""Continuum outgoing line check of the endpoint and finite-distance detector until both cuts open."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import brentq

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path("software/stage1_solver/tools").resolve()))
from mouth_contact_tracking import WallTrace

def continuum(mesh, eta, span=.04):
    trace=WallTrace(mesh,.5)
    upper=trace.crossing(.95)
    shift=np.array([-span/2,+span/2])
    fail=trace.crossing(2*abs(eta))-shift
    end=np.max(fail)
    p=np.array([-1.,1.])
    def weights(z,ids):
        c,dc=trace.sample(trace.chi,z+shift)
        return c*ids/2,dc*ids/2
    k0,_=weights(upper,np.ones(2))
    x0=k0@p/sum(k0)
    E0=k0@((x0-p)**2)/2
    y=np.array([x0,0.,0.,0.])
    splits=np.unique(np.r_[upper,end,fail,trace.edges,trace.edges-shift[0],trace.edges-shift[1]])
    splits=splits[(splits>=upper)&(splits<=end)]
    histories=[]
    sever=0.
    events=[]
    for l,r in zip(splits[:-1],splits[1:]):
        ids=.5*(l+r)<fail
        if r<=l:raise ValueError
        def rhs(z,v):
            interior=np.clip(z,np.nextafter(l,r),np.nextafter(r,l))
            k,dk=weights(interior,ids)
            F=k@(p-v[0])
            tprime=1/trace.speed(interior)
            return [F*tprime,tprime,F**2*tprime,-.5*dk@((v[0]-p)**2)]
        dense=solve_ivp(rhs,(l,r),y,dense_output=True,rtol=2e-12,atol=1e-14,method='DOP853')
        if not dense.success: raise ValueError(dense.message)
        a=y[1]
        y=dense.y[:,-1]
        histories.append((a,y[1],l,r,dense.sol))
        if np.any(fail==r):
            k,_=weights(r,ids)
            ev=(fail==r).astype(float)
            sever+=.5*(k*ev)@((p-y[0])**2)
            events.append({'t':y[1],'z':r,'chi':trace.sample(trace.chi,r)[0],'unloaded_pre':k@p/sum(k),'actual':y[0],'work':y[2]})
    def W(t):
        if t<=0:return 0.
        for a,b,l,r,sol in histories:
            if a<=t<=b:
                z=brentq(lambda z:sol(z)[1]-t,l,r,xtol=1.e-14)
                return sol(z)[2]
        return y[2]
    ds=[.125,.25,.5,.75,1.,1.5,2.,2.5,3.,4.]
    budget=y[2]+y[3]+sever
    print(json.dumps(dict(mesh=mesh,eta=eta,events=events,W_over_initial=y[2]/E0,softening=y[3]/E0,sever=sever/E0,closure=budget-E0,cut={d:W(y[1]-d)/E0 for d in ds})),flush=True)
    assert abs(budget-E0)<1e-9
for n,eta in [(48,.125),(34,.125),(48,.25)]:continuum(n,eta)

"""Blind reconstruction of the two work meters and unloaded offsets from saved readings."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
base=Path('_scratch/s11c/contact_tagged_work01')
expected={r['mesh']:r for r in []}
refs=[json.loads(l) for l in Path('_scratch/s11c/tagged_ordered_review01/stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
for line in (base/'stdout').read_text().splitlines():
    row=json.loads(line)
    path=Path(row['raw_path'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['raw_sha256']
    with np.load(path) as n:
        s=dict(zip(n['columns'],n['samples'].T))
    dt,t=s['dt'],s['time']
    fk=s['force_on_ordered']
    va=s['ordered_end_velocity']
    actual0=row['probes'][0]['ordered_end_slip']
    x=actual0+np.cumsum(va*dt)-.5*dt*va
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x,s['ordered_end_slip'],atol=1e-16)
    f0,f1=s['probe_force_minus'],s['probe_force_plus']
    a,b=row['probe_slips']
    live=(s['live_upstream']+s['live_downstream'])>0
    xr=a-(b-a)*f0[live]/(f1[live]-f0[live])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(s['zero_force_slip'][live],xr,atol=5e-17)
    assert np.all(np.isnan(s['zero_force_slip'][~live]))
    f_interpolated=f0[live]+(x[live]-a)*(f1[live]-f0[live])/(b-a)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fk[live],f_interpolated,atol=5e-17)
    endpoint=np.cumsum(dt*fk*va)
    cut=np.cumsum(dt*s['cut_force']*s['cut_velocity'])
    for m in row['probes']+row['events']:
        j=np.searchsorted(t,m['time'])-1
        for measure,energy in [('endpoint_work',endpoint),('cut_work',cut)]:
            value=0. if j<0 else energy[j]
            assert abs(m[measure]-value)<1e-19
    if row['frozen']:
        assert row['status']=='still_connected' and row['events']==[] and live.all()
        continue
    last=row['events'][-1]; assert last['zero_force_slip'] is None and row['events'][-2]['zero_force_slip'] is not None
    assert all(fk[~live]==0.)
    erow=row['initial_energy']
    if erow==0:continue
    w=last['endpoint_work']/erow
    c=last['cut_work']/erow
    reference=next(data for data in refs if data['mesh']==row['mesh'] and data['eta']==row['registry'])
    print(json.dumps(dict(case=row['case'],endpoint=w,point25=c,endpoint_minus_continuum=w-reference['W_over_initial'],point25_minus_continuum=c-reference['cut']['0.25'],sample_count=len(t))))

import json, math, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
root=Path('_scratch/s11c')
for name in ('constant','center'):
    path=root/f'contact_tagged_{name}01'
    run=json.loads((path/'stdout').read_text())
    record=json.loads((path/'outcome.json').read_text())
    limit=json.loads((path/'limit-validation.json').read_text())
    assert record['exitCode']==record['childOutcome']['exitCode']==0 and record['limitsVerified'] and limit['verified'] and int(limit['actual']['memory.swap.max'])==0
    raw=Path(run['raw_path'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==run['raw_sha256']
    with np.load(raw) as read:
        cols=dict(zip(read['columns'],read['samples'].T))
    if name=='center':
        assert not run['events'] and run['status']=='still_connected' and cols['live_upstream'].all() and cols['live_downstream'].all()
        where=run['probes'][-1]
        assert all(where['live_lobes']) and min(where['overlap_margin'])>0.
        assert abs(where['center_order']-.01)<1e-12
    else:
        s=run['events']; where=s[-1]
        assert [v['live_lobes'] for v in s]==[[1,1],[1,0],[1,0],[0,0]]
        assert [(cols['k_'+p]==.5*cols['live_'+p]).all() for p in ['upstream','downstream']]==[True,True]
        assert where['softening']==0 and s[0]['endpoint_work']==0.
    receipt=(cols['time']<=where['time'])*cols['dt']
    w=receipt @ (cols['force_on_ordered']*cols['ordered_end_velocity'])/run['initial_energy']
    cut=receipt @ (cols['cut_force']*cols['cut_velocity'])/run['initial_energy']
    assert abs(w-where['endpoint_work']/run['initial_energy'])<1e-12 and abs(cut-where['cut_work']/run['initial_energy'])<1e-12
    out=dict(name=name,net=w,cut=cut,stage=where['stage'],time=where['time'],root=where['zero_force_slip'])
    if name=='constant':
        d=s[-1]['time']-s[0]['time']
        out['analytic_endpoint']=-math.expm1(-d)/2
        out['analytic_cut']=-math.expm1(-max(d-run['cut'],0.))/2
        assert abs(w-out['analytic_endpoint'])<2e-4 and abs(cut-out['analytic_cut'])<3e-3
    print(json.dumps(out),flush=True)
